validated_objective: Deliver the first executable Quality Intent Framework baseline: entity model, lifecycle model, discovery workflow, evaluation workflow, governance workflow, acceptance framework, canonical schemas, sample package, and local validator.
scope: Canonical machine-readable schema for a QIF package under schemas/.
Local validator under tools/ and npm script for repeatable verification.
AOF runtime evidence log connecting Need Validation, direction, review, self-review, and retrospective.
constraints: Do not define quality as page count, review count, test count, or any activity volume.
Do not make the framework software-development-specific.
Do not build a production app in this slice.
Confidence and verdicts must be traceable to evidence, source reliability, coverage, recency, independence, and contradiction signals.
expected_outcomes: QIF can be executed by humans, AI agents, or hybrid organizations using the same artifacts.
The repository contains a validating sample and clear acceptance gates for future QIF packages.
